IconRegistry.ts imports each icon by subpath (lucide-react-native/icons/<file>, 335 imports of 327 files) so Metro bundles only those, not the barrel; file names are lucide's own (Home lives in house), so a bump must re-check them: the IconRegistry snapshot test fails on any changed glyph. 1.28 → 1.67 (2026-11-03) renamed 10 files (trash-2→trash, smile/frown/meh→face-*, music*→*-notes, building-2→building-complex, book-marked→book-bookmark, circle-parking→circle-letter-p); the registry KEYS are stored in user databases and never change, only the import paths did. jest.config.js maps the barrel and the subpaths to the CJS build, which jest can parse.
